items.title: Abbie Williams Interview, 1966-06-02
items.q: And I had this girl Alma Money, Monday.

ctx.x: And you had plenty of time then between the different fights, the three Lama's and the main bout and everything, so you could actually get some numbers in there. Yeah. You could actually just play one chorus. I see, I always wondered about it because I never saw a band.

And we would fight fans. Yeah. We would fight fans, we loved it. And we didn't get but six bucks. And I played over here at St. Philip and St. Claude, I played over there for a long time. And I had this girl Alma Money, Monday. Alma, she's across the lake now.
Yeah, I never did know her. Piano player.
